newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia demonopolisation decree being readied - Yasin.
newsitem.headline: Russia demonopolisation decree being readied - Yasin.

text.p: The presidential administration is preparing a decree on reforming natural monopolies including power utility Unified Energy System and Gazprom natural gas producer, former Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin said on Monday.
"A presidential decree is now being prepared, which will give orders on concrete decisions," Yasin told a news conference.
He said the Economy Ministry had prepared a programme on natural monopolies restructuring and set up special groups to present suggestions on individual companies.
New Economy Minister Yakov Urinson said a cabinet meeting would discuss the issue at its next sitting on April 3.
"Concrete actions -- the next stage -- is being considered by Nemtsov," Urinson said.
"These questions were actively discussed last Saturday. At its next meeting the government will look at questions of UES EESR.RTS, the Railways Ministry, Gazprom GAZP.RTS," he said.
Russian officials say the International Monetary Fund insists Russia include measures on natural monopoly reform in its 1997 economic programme, to be agreed by Russia and the IMF.
First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov said on Sunday in a television interview that Russia needed lower prices for energy, transport and communications to stimulate economic growth.
